whk_gemiddelde_premie_2026.label: Gemiddelde gedifferentieerde premie Werkhervattingskas (Whk) 2026
whk_gemiddelde_premie_2026.value: WGA gemiddeld 0,96% ; Ziektewet (ZW) gemiddeld 0,56% ; totaal gemiddeld 1,52%
whk_gemiddelde_premie_2026.source_name: UWV, Gedifferentieerde premies WGA en Ziektewet 2026
whk_gemiddelde_premie_2026.note: This is the national average rate, not an employer- or sector-specific rate: large and medium employers receive an individually experience-rated premium (gedifferentieerde premie) based on their own claims history; small employers (loonsom <= EUR 1,082,500 in 2024) receive a sector-based rate derived from the same national averages. No single rate applies economy-wide by construction, so the national average is used here as the standard reference, consistent with the AT/EP convention used in the Spain module.

validation.method: Independent cross-check against a secondary net-minimum-wage figure (not against a formula, to avoid circularity).
validation.note: For a 36h/week minimum-wage employee at the January 2026 rate (14.71 EUR/hour, gross 2 294.76 EUR/month), this module's loonheffing_2026.py computes a net monthly wage of 2 178.38 EUR, versus 2 146.13 EUR reported independently by a secondary source (nettoloonberekenen.nl / salarisvanmorgen.nl, January 2026 rate) -- a 1.5% gap, consistent with minor differences between the continuous annual formula used here and the official monthly withholding tables.
